summary.text: Linda Foley is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 15 who has served since December 17, 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as executive.

paragraphs.text: Foley earned a B.S. in journalism from Northwestern University in 1997.
Her career experience includes serving as chair of the Montgomery County Democratic Party, president of the Berger-Marks Foundation, and a consultant with the National Labor Coordinating Committee.
Gov. Larry Hogan appointed Foley to the House of Delegates to replace Kathleen Dumais.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Environment and Transportation Committee.
